events.title: Employee is killed when shot by customer
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Midnight Mine Llc. Fairbanks, AK. At 3:15 a.m. on January 15, 2025, Employee #1 was taking out the trash when he was shot by a former customer. The employee suffered fatal injuries as a result of the gunshot wound.

events.title: Employee is shot and killed by patron
events.description: 1 worker death. Fairbanks, AK. At 3:15 a.m. on January 15, 2025, Employee #1 was going outside to address a patron when the patron shot the employee. The employee suffered fatal gunshot wounds.

events.title: Employee experiences fatal cardiovascular event while drivin…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Summit Windows & Doors, Inc. Anchorage, AK. At 1:00 p.m. on August 23, 2024, an employee, while driving a company van for delivery purposes, experienced a cardiovascular event. The employee was not engaged in any identifiable work-related activity that contributed to the event,and no discernible workplace cause was identified. Emergency services were called, but the employee was later pronounced dead due to the cardiovascular event.

events.title: Employee is killed when shot during workplace violence incid…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Weidner Property Management Llc. Anchorage, AK. At 3:00 p.m. on October 23, 2023, an employee was working in the office. A tenant, who was being issued a non-renewal, came into the office and shot the employee. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall to lower level
events.description: 1 worker death. Fairbanks, AK. At 9:30 a.m. on October 13, 2022, an employee was standing on an unprotected edge of an upper mezzanine level. The employee reached for something that was being tossed up to him and fell to the cement floor. The employee was killed due to a fatal head injury.

events.title: Employee dies of natural causes after slipping and falling
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Alyeska Seafoods, Inc. Unalaska, AK. At 11:45 p.m. on March 3, 2022, an employee was working as a fisher for a firm that processed fresh and frozen seafood. She was walking across an improved road from the firm's galley to the firm's Surimi processing plant after lunch, when she fell, onto a concrete surface. There were no witnesses to the incident. She was found shortly thereafter, and an ambulance was called. She was taken to a clinic for evaluation, where she gave a statement about her fall. She was sent to her room with…

events.title: Employee is killed due to head injury after fall from ladder…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Hilcorp Alaska, Llc. Anchorage, AK. At 1:15 a.m. on December 9, 2021, an employee had been standing on a ladder installing an airplane wing tip. The employee lost his balance and fell hitting his head on the concrete floor. The employee incurred blunt force trauma to the head and was killed.

events.title: Employee with Covid-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Anchorage, AK. The employer noticed the employee was coughing and exhibiting signs. The employee notified management on October 2, 2021, that he thought he might have COVID-19 and planned to work remotely. The employee notified management on October 6, 2021, of his positive test result. The employee was hospitalized on October 9, 2021. During the week of October 10 to the 16, everyone with first contact was tested for COVID-19. The employee died from complications from the virus at 12:00 a.m. on October 19,…

events.title: Employee is killed after being run over by truck
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Blue Arctic Waste Soluttions, Llc. Anchorage, AK. At 7:00 a.m. on March 25, 2021, an employee was driving a garbage truck when pulled up to a residence to empty a trash can. The employee lowered the trash truck's arm but was unable to lift the can due to it being frozen to the ground.The employee exited the truck when the truck began to slide on the ice. The truck's extended arm knocked over the employee who fell underneath the truck and was killed.

events.title: Employee dies from heart attack while stocking shelves
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Craig Taylor Equipment Company. Soldotna, AK. At 12:30 p.m. on January 13, 2021, an employee was stocking shelves when he had a heart attack and died.

events.title: Employee installing garage door is killed by carbon monoxide…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Door Tech, Llc. Wasilla, AK. At 5:00 p.m. on November 5, 2020, Employee #1 was found unresponsive at a residential building's garage when a carbon monoxide alarm inside the residence triggered an emergency response. The employee had been installing a garage door. Employee #1 was killed by exposure to toxic carbon monoxide fumes. fumes.

events.title: Employee dies from unknown cause and awaiting results from M…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Danny'S Auto Body And Paint. Anchorage, AK. On October 25, 2017, an employee was spray painting a car. The employee died from unknown causes, and awaiting results from the medical examiner.

events.title: Employee is mauled by bear and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Soloy Helicopters, Llc. Wasilla, AK. On June 22, 2017, an employee was taking samples in a remote area, when he was attacked by a bear and was killed.

events.title: Employee is mauled by bear and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Geotemps, Inc. Fairbanks, AK. At 7:00 a.m. on June 18, 2017, an employee was working outdoors to perform sampling activities when he was attacked by a black bear. He suffered acute trauma, resulting in his death.

events.title: Employee collapses and dies from probable medical condition…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bradshaw & Associates Inc. Anchorage, AK. At 10:22 a.m. on March 7, 2017, an employee was preparing to offload trash from a pickup truck. There were no witnesses to the actual event, however statements and footage gathered indicate that while in the process of uncovering the load in the bed of the pickup, the employee collapsed onto the ground. The employee died from cardiac arrest.

events.title: Employee is crushed and killed when caught in ice machine
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: E.C. Phillips & Son, Inc. Ketchikan, AK. At 1:45 p.m. on November 1, 2016, an employee was clearing ice from inside an ice making machine. The ice machine engaged and crushed the employee. The employee was killed from asphyxiation.

events.title: Employee is crushed and killed when wall collapses
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: North Country Services. Anchorage, AK. At approximately 3:30 p.m. on September 30, 2016, Employee #1 was part of a crewdemolishing a wooden staircase. A structure which allowed the staircase to support a 5 foot tall concrete retaining wall had been removed. The concrete wall became unstable and an approximately 29 foot section collapsed. Employee #1 was partially trapped underneath the wall and suffered fractured ribs and pelvis and died from asphyxiation.

events.description: 1 worker death. Eagle River, AK. At 10:30 a.m. on August 2, 2016, an employee was preparing to do work on a well system and had the truck backed into the area to access the well head. The employee was using a cable connected control box to rotate the truck mounted crane from the bed position over the top of the cab. The boom was moved from thefront of the truck to the right side of the truck where the wire cable made contact with the overhead power lines. events.title: Employee Dies from Heart Attack At Desk
events.description: 1 worker death. Elmendorf Afb, AK. At 8:30 a.m. on March 22, 2016, an employee was sitting at her desk working. The employee stopped responding to a conversation with her co-worker in an adjacent office. When that co-worker entered the office to see what was wrong, the employee was slumped over her desk and unresponsive.

events.title: Employee Is Stabbed By Front Loader Mast and Is Killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Construction Machinery Industrial, Llc. Anchorage, AK. At 1:00 p.m. on December 14, 2015, an employee was winterizing a Volvo L70G front end loader and had replaced several factory hydraulic hoses with winter grade hoses. The employee removed too many hoses and the mast of the front end loader lost hydraulic pressure, came down on top of him, and crushed his back and shoulders. The employee was killed when impaled through his lower abdomen. abdomen.

events.title: Employee is attacked and killed by Patient
events.description: 1 worker death. Anchorage, AK. On November 16, 2015, an employee was caring for adults with disabilities when he was attacked by one of his patients. The employee suffered multiple injuries that resulted in his death.
